title: Straight to the cheese
goal: The cheese is straight ahead. Drive the mouse onto it!
`motors(left, right)` sets the power of each wheel (up to `0.15`) and waits one tick. Repeat it to keep moving.
hints: The loop runs `motors` 10 times. Is that enough ticks to get there?
Faster wheels (closer to `0.15`) reach the cheese sooner.
name: Straight to the cheese
